summary.text: Eric Emery is a Democratic state representative from District 26A who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Eric Emery's career experience includes working as a paramedic, according to Ballotpedia.
He assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 10, 2023, succeeding Shawn Bordeaux.
In the 2025-2026 session, Emery serves on the House Government Operations and Audit Committee, the House Health and Human Services Committee and the House State Affairs Committee.
